levels.note: Race condition, no source. Recon: fopen(path, 'w') CREATES the file as euid=level10, so the binary's own stat check (st_uid must equal geteuid() = 1010) passes on the file it just made; it writes the message, prints Write Ok, sleeps 2s (THE race window), reopens the path, reads 128 bytes and prints them. Attack: run it in a 777 directory we own; during the window unlink the level10-owned file and symlink it to /pass/level10 - the binary reads the password. Verified live 2026-11-25: error:U_sux0rZ, level10 login confirmed.

levels.note: PATH hijack on system("clear"). The binary calls setuid(geteuid()) then system("clear") before the password game: the clear command runs through sh -c with PATH under our control, and the child keeps euid=level11. We put a script named 'clear' (cat /pass/level11) first on PATH; the game itself always fails (strlen never equals the magic compare), but by then our clear has already printed the level11 password. Verified live 2026-11-25: phj33r_tuX, level11 login confirmed.
